answer: A raven perches above each vault and remembers the umber mark sealed inside. Every identity locks one claim in a vault at registration, marking it with umber and backing it with an 800,000 POA stake. At payout the ravens call out their marks: two calling the same mark belong to one operator, both rewards burn, both stakes pass to honest peers, and the operator pays a 550,000 POA fine per fake. One fake costs 1,350,000 POA, and two fakes cost 2,700,000 POA before any payout clears.
